delivery_modes.label: Normal Delivery
delivery_modes.customer_meaning: Standard delivery, system auto-schedules within 4h SLA. No need to pick a time.
delivery_modes.customer_meaning_vi: Flexible delivery; the system auto-schedules within a 4-hour SLA without requiring a specific time slot. 0% surcharge. Customers drop off packages within 2 hours of placing the order.

delivery_modes.label: Scheduled Delivery
delivery_modes.customer_meaning: Customer chooses a desired delivery time / flexible shipment.
delivery_modes.customer_meaning_vi: Customer selects a preferred delivery time window with zero service surcharge (0%). Specific departure and arrival times are computed by the system upon estimation/booking.

delivery_modes.label: Express Delivery

payment_status.UNPAID: Payment link has not been created or payment is not completed yet.
payment_status.PENDING: Payment has not been confirmed yet.
payment_status.CANCELLED: The payment session/order payment was cancelled.

order_creation.title: How to Create a Delivery Order
order_creation.summary: 9-step workflow to place a Hub-to-Hub drone delivery order.
order_creation.content: To create an order on DroneOptAI: (1) Enter sender and recipient details -> (2) Select package category, weight (max 10kg), and size (S/M/L/XL) -> (3) Select Origin Hub and Destination Hub -> (4) Choose Scheduled or Express mode -> (5) Review the system quotation -> (6) Complete payment via PayOS -> (7) Bring the package to the Origin Hub before the Handover Deadline -> (8) Track flight progress -> (9) Recipient collects the package at the Destination Hub.

hub_to_hub.title: Hub-to-Hub Delivery Model
hub_to_hub.summary: Package drop-off and pickup at fixed DroneOptAI Hubs.
hub_to_hub.content: DroneOptAI operates on a Hub-to-Hub model: senders drop off packages at the Origin Hub and recipients collect them at the Destination Hub. The system does not perform direct door-to-door pickup or delivery at arbitrary private addresses outside the Hub network.

package_rules.title: Package Size & Weight Rules
package_rules.summary: 4 size tiers (S, M, L, XL) with a maximum weight limit of 10 kg.
package_rules.content: The system supports 8 package categories (food, documents, electronics, medical, clothing, household, fragile, other) and 4 package sizes: Size S (≤ 1 kg, 20×20×15 cm), Size M (≤ 3 kg, 30×25×20 cm), Size L (≤ 5 kg, 40×30×25 cm), Size XL (≤ 10 kg, 50×40×30 cm). Fragile packages carry a +15% Core Fee surcharge.

pricing.title: Shipping Fee & Pricing Rules
pricing.summary: Core Fee formula and service surcharge rates.
pricing.content: Core Fee = Base Fee + Distance Fee (km × rate/km) + Payload Fee (kg × rate/kg). Rates by size: S (20,000 VND + 4,000 VND/km + 3,000 VND/kg), M (30,000 VND + 5,000 VND/km + 4,000 VND/kg), L (45,000 VND + 6,000 VND/km + 5,000 VND/kg), XL (65,000 VND + 8,000 VND/km + 6,000 VND/kg). All surcharges are calculated directly from the Core Fee (not compounded): Fragile +15%, Insurance +10%, Express +25%, Scheduled +0%.

delivery_modes.title: Delivery Modes: Normal, Scheduled, and Express
delivery_modes.summary: Comparison of Normal (4h SLA), Scheduled, and Express (priority) modes.
delivery_modes.content: Normal Delivery: 0% surcharge, auto-scheduled within a 4h SLA without picking a time slot, package handover within 2h. Scheduled Delivery: 0% surcharge, customer picks a specific delivery time, handover at least 3h before flight. Express Delivery: +25% Core Fee, prioritized for the earliest available flight schedule. Exact estimated departure and arrival times are always retrieved directly from the system quotation or order record.

handover_deadline.title: Package Handover Deadline
handover_deadline.summary: Deadline for the sender to drop off the package at the Origin Hub.
handover_deadline.content: The Handover Deadline is the latest time by which the sender must bring the package to the Origin Hub so staff can prepare battery mounting and flight scheduling for the Drone. Each order's exact deadline is displayed in its order details.

payment.title: Payment Help
payment.summary: Online payment via PayOS gateway / QR code.
payment.content: Orders are paid via the PayOS gateway (VietQR scan or bank transfer using the checkout link). Payment statuses: PENDING (awaiting payment confirmation), PAID (payment confirmed), CANCELLED (payment session cancelled).

fragile.title: Fragile Items
fragile.summary: Surcharge rule for the fragile package category.
fragile.content: When selecting the fragile category, the system applies a +15% handling surcharge calculated on the Core Fee. Detailed insurance or compensation policies beyond fee calculation rules are not currently published as an official policy in the system.

insurance.title: Package Insurance
insurance.summary: Optional insurance at +10% of Core Fee.
insurance.content: Customers may optionally purchase package insurance for +10% of the Core Fee. Note: Detailed terms regarding coverage scope, compensation limits, and claim procedures do not currently have an officially published policy document in the system.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.content: An order can only be requested for cancellation while it is in PENDING status, has not yet been handed over at the Origin Hub, and has not entered an active flight mission. To confirm whether a specific order can be cancelled, the system checks the live status of that order directly.

notifications.title: System Notifications
notifications.summary: Order status updates and package pickup reminders.
notifications.content: The system automatically sends notifications for flight status updates, payment confirmations, overdue cancellation warnings, and reminders for recipients to collect packages at the Destination Hub.

collection.title: Destination Hub Collection
collection.summary: Rules once a package arrives at the Destination Hub.
collection.content: A package is only 'Ready for collection' once the order/handover status confirms arrival at the Destination Hub. After arrival, the system sends pickup reminders every 5 hours; if uncollected after 5 days, the shipment will be cancelled under operational rules.
